theme: Light & Dark Toggle (Primary focus on Premium Dark Mode for AI/Finance vibe)
archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (adapted for Premium Finance / Mobile)

typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Use tracking-tight for headings.

spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid border color for definition, flat backgrounds.

navigation.style: Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl), height 80px, icons scale up 1.1x on active.

cards.style: Flat, 1px border. No shadows in dark mode. Very subtle shadow in light mode. Use surface color.
cards.ai_insight_card: Highlight with a subtle left border (2px) using accent_neutral.

buttons.primary: Pill shape, full width for main actions, highly contrasting text.

charts.sparklines: Used in watchlists/dashboard lists. 2px stroke, no axis, colored by bullish/bearish.
charts.candlesticks: Main stock view. 4px body, 1px wick, 2px gap. Green/Red.
charts.ai_prediction_line: Dashed line extending from current price.
charts.confidence_intervals: Overlapping polygons (70%, 90%, 95%) behind the prediction line with descending opacity (30%, 20%, 10%).

badges.sentiment: Small pill, background tint + text color (e.g., Bullish = green bg + green text).

auth.description: Welcome screen with AI branding. Sign in with Apple/Google buttons (full width, icon left, text center). Email/password standard inputs.

dashboard.header: Greeting + Portfolio Total Value (massive mono font) + Daily P&L.
dashboard.market_sentiment: Gauge or horizontal bar chart showing overall AI sentiment (0-100 score).
dashboard.top_movers: Horizontal scroll of Bento-style cards showing Top Predicted Gainers/Losers with confidence %.

screener.header: Sticky horizontal scroll filter chips (Confidence, Return, Sector, Cap).
screener.list: Vertical list. Each row shows Ticker, Company Name, Current Price, AI Score (0-100), Direction Arrow, and Accuracy %.

stock_detail.chart: Interactive candlestick chart + AI prediction cone (confidence intervals).
stock_detail.ai_reasoning: Bento card showing 'Feature Importance' (horizontal bars for RSI, MACD, Volume, etc.) and LLM text summary.
stock_detail.similar_patterns: Horizontal list of historical charts that match current setup.

watchlist.layout: Vertical list. Swipe left to remove. Row shows Ticker, Sparkline, AI Prediction Direction, Price.
watchlist.live_indicator: Pulsing dot for real-time model updates.

alerts.layout: Tabs: Active / Triggered. Cards showing Target Price, Current Distance progress bar, Notification toggles.

settings_and_paywall.paywall: Full-screen modal. Immersive dark theme regardless of app theme. High contrast, glassy checkmarks, 'Unlock AI Alpha' CTA.

motion_and_interaction.prediction_reveal: When AI data loads, staggered fade-in with slight vertical translation (Y: 10px -> 0px).
motion_and_interaction.chart_scrubbing: Crosshair with Haptic Feedback (impact light) on each candlestick focus.
motion_and_interaction.swipe_actions: Spring physics for watchlist row deletion.

images.description: Abstract glowing bull, represents premium AI market analysis.
Close up of digital market data, darkened with overlay for paywall backdrop.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST include testID (React Native) or data-testid. Format: kebab-case, role-based. Example: testID='screener-filter-chip'

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React Native Expo application. Use View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, etc. DO NOT use HTML tags.
Implement light and dark mode securely using NativeWind colorScheme or a custom context.
For icons, use vector icons like @expo/vector-icons or phosphor-react-native.
For charts, use react-native-svg or react-native-wagmi-charts/victory-native. Ensure confidence intervals are drawn securely.
Strictly adhere to the color hex codes for Bullish/Bearish states.
For the paywall, use Stripe React Native SDK if applicable, or mock the UI beautifully.
Ensure all interactive elements have testID props.
